errors._screen: Error messages of signing in and of the session, shown under the field or on the sign-in screen. One per error code the API returns. Short, say what happened and what to do next; never blame the person.
errors.too_many_code_requests: Rate limit on asking for codes; do not give the limit or the wait time.
errors.too_many_attempts: Rate limit on typing codes; do not give the limit or the wait time.
errors.contact_support: Shown when the account cannot be opened with this identity (an email already used by another account). Do not mention the other account.
